title: The Billionaire Tactic That Uses Your DNA to Deny You Insurance
hook: Ultra-wealthy insurers buy your genetic data from direct-to-consumer tests to quietly spike your premiums before you get sick.

hook: Credit card companies use a cognitive bias called 'mental accounting' to make you treat borrowed money like free money, trapping you in a debt spiral.
